discovery.query: finite planar graph shortest path distance counterexample localization

inspection.description: Compute every exact unweighted shortest-path distance in a finite simple graph of at most 64 vertices, using JSON null for unreachable vertex pairs.

input.vertices: array of strings; maxItems 256; each string length 1..256

inspection.row_contract: Each row contains source:string and distances:array[integer in 0..255 or null], bound to the returned canonical vertex axis.

scope: The six-vertex unweighted graph is within both the advertised and schema bounds. This operation does not accept weighted column geometry and is not used as a proof of localization.
